patterns.pattern: What are you doing? I'm + verb-ing.

grammar.title: Can / Can't (Ability)
grammar.explain_en: We use 'can' to say what someone is able to do. We use 'can't' to say what someone is not able to do.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'can' để nói về những gì ai đó có thể làm. Chúng ta dùng 'can't' để nói về những gì ai đó không thể làm.

grammar.title: Present Simple (Habits & Likes)
grammar.explain_en: We use the Present Simple to talk about things we do regularly, or things we like and dislike.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì Hiện tại đơn để nói về những việc chúng ta làm thường xuyên, hoặc những điều chúng ta thích và không thích.

grammar.title: Present Continuous (Actions Happening Now)
grammar.explain_en: We use the Present Continuous to talk about actions that are happening right now, at this moment.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì Hiện tại tiếp diễn để nói về những hành động đang xảy ra ngay bây giờ, vào lúc này.
examples: I am running in the park now.

grammar.title: Have got / Has got (Possession)
grammar.explain_en: We use 'have got' or 'has got' to say that someone owns or possesses something.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'have got' hoặc 'has got' để nói rằng ai đó sở hữu một thứ gì đó.
examples: I have got a new ball.
He has got a blue bicycle.
We have got three friends on our team.
Have you got a jump rope?
grammar.right: ✅ I have got a red ball.

readings.title: My Favorite Game
readings.text: Hello! My name is Minh. I am eight years old. I like to play outside with my friends. My favorite game is 'Hide-and-Seek'. It is so much fun! We run and hide in the park. My friend Linh is very good at finding. She can run very fast! Sometimes, we play 'Tag'. I can't run as fast as Linh, but I try my best. After playing, I feel happy and a little tired. Playing games makes me healthy and strong. I love playing with my friends every day!

readings.title: A Day at the Sports Field
readings.text: It's Saturday morning, and Ben is at the sports field with his friends. The sun is shining, and it's a perfect day for sports! Ben loves playing soccer. He is kicking the ball with his team. They are wearing blue shirts. Lucy is also here. She likes basketball. She is throwing the ball and practicing shooting hoops. Nam is riding his bike around the track. He is very fast! Mai and Tom are playing a game of catch with a soft ball. They can catch very well. Everyone is exercising and having a good time. They know that playing sports helps them stay active and happy. They are all getting strong and healthy today!

readings.title: Staying Healthy and Active
readings.text: Having a healthy body is very important for all of us. How can we stay healthy and active? One good way is to play sports and games! Every morning, my dad and I go to the park. He runs, and I ride my small bike. I can ride fast now! My sister, An, likes to jump rope. She can jump for a long time. She is very strong. At school, during break time, my friends and I often play different games. Sometimes we play badminton, sometimes we just run around. We always try to move our bodies. Playing sports helps our hearts and muscles grow strong. It also helps us feel happy and sleep well at night. When we are active, we have more energy to learn and play. So, let's all find a sport or game we love and play it every day!

life_skill.title: BE ACTIVE, BE HEALTHY!
life_skill.intro: Being active means moving your body every day. It helps you stay healthy, strong, and happy! Let's learn how to be active.
life_skill.intro_vi: Năng động có nghĩa là vận động cơ thể mỗi ngày. Điều đó giúp em khỏe mạnh, mạnh mẽ và vui vẻ! Hãy cùng học cách năng động nhé.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Running makes your heart strong, just like a pump!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The fastest person in the world can run as fast as 45 kilometers per hour!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Playing outside helps you get Vitamin D from the sun, which is good for your bones!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? There are more than 8,000 different types of sports and games around the world!

classroom_game.name: Sporty Charades
steps_en: 1. Divide the class into small groups.
2. Each group gets a list of action verbs related to sports (e.g., run, jump, swim, kick, throw, dance, ride a bike).
3. One student from a group secretly picks a word and acts it out without speaking.
4. Their group guesses the action. The first group to guess correctly gets a point.
5. The game continues with other students acting out words.
steps_vi: 1. Chia lớp thành các nhóm nhỏ.
2. Mỗi nhóm nhận một danh sách các động từ hành động liên quan đến thể thao (ví dụ: chạy, nhảy, bơi, đá, ném, nhảy múa, đạp xe).
3. Một học sinh từ mỗi nhóm bí mật chọn một từ và diễn tả hành động đó mà không nói.
4. Nhóm của bạn đó đoán hành động. Nhóm nào đoán đúng đầu tiên sẽ được một điểm.
5. Trò chơi tiếp tục với các học sinh khác diễn tả hành động.
